messages:
keisha: Heads-up team  activating a temporary rail signal on the release train while we mitigate an unusual pattern of hardware preemptions in us-west. Estimated window 18-36h. Please hold new submissions for 90m. :warning:

deploy-bot: [auto] canary-scan: 11/52 canaries degraded in region=us-west. Dashboard: https://internal.ops/canary

ravi: Quick question  what's the exception policy if a customer-facing rollback is needed?

keisha: Exceptions now require a documented release-exception issue plus two approvers (release-manager + ops-oncall). This is temporary until the eviction pattern is stable. Only P0 production-facing fixes qualify.

ops-oncall: Note: Dedicated/reserved pools are not affected by the preemptions, but autoscaler shifts may change background capacity. If you have strict SLAs, open an infra-alloc ticket and tag @ops-oncall.

maria: We'll proactively reassign non-pinned canaries to eu-west and apac to keep validation moving. To keep a canary in place, comment on its ticket with `pin:us-west`. Owners will get DM notifications when we reassign.

deploy-bot: Helpful commands:
```
rictl canary list --region=us-west --filter=movable=true
rictl canary migrate --id=<id> --target=eu-west
```

keisha: Posting a status update in 2h or sooner if the infra pattern changes. Thanks for standing down PRs for now and for flagging urgent exceptions here. :thumbsup:
